q24256.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed, both by day and by night, to give useful warnings in order to avoid accidents.

explain.short: A quick flash of the main beam is a light signal. It can warn others of a danger at any time of day.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'sia di giorno che di notte' (both by day and by night) is correct: the warning flash has no time limit.

sceneParams.caption: Flash to warn: allowed day and night
lines: To warn and avoid an accident
Allowed by day and by night

keywords.it: sia di giorno che di notte
keywords.en: both by day and by night

q24257.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed, also inside towns, to give useful warnings in order to avoid accidents.

explain.short: The warning flash is a light signal that can replace the horn. Inside towns it is even better than the horn.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'anche all'interno dei centri abitati' (also inside towns) is correct: the flash is allowed in towns too.

sceneParams.caption: Flash to warn: allowed in towns too
lines: Flash the main beam to warn

q24258.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed to tell the vehicle in front, both by day and by night, that you intend to overtake.

explain.short: A short flash tells the driver in front that you want to overtake. This is allowed at any time of day.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'l'intenzione di sorpassare' (the intention to overtake) is one of the two allowed reasons for flashing.

sceneParams.caption: Flash to say 'I am overtaking': allowed
lines: Flash to say: I want to overtake
Allowed by day and by night

q24259.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed to tell the vehicle in front, also inside towns, that you intend to overtake.

explain.short: Signalling an overtake with a flash is allowed everywhere, towns included. In towns it replaces the horn.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'anche all'interno dei centri abitati' (also inside towns) is correct for this signal.

sceneParams.caption: Flash before overtaking: allowed in towns too

q24260.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed only on roads outside towns.

explain.short: The flash is allowed inside towns too, to warn of danger or to signal an overtake.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is the trap: there is no limit to roads outside towns.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing is allowed in towns too

q24261.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed also in urban centres, but only by day.

explain.short: In towns the flash is allowed by day and by night. There is no 'daytime only' rule.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'unicamente di giorno' (only by day) is the trap: night is allowed too.

sceneParams.caption: In towns: allowed day AND night

q24262.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed only when carrying injured or seriously ill people.

explain.short: Anyone may flash to warn of danger or to signal an overtake. It is not only for transporting sick people.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'solo quando si trasportano feriti' (only when carrying injured people) is the trap: the reasons are warning and overtaking.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing is not only for carrying the injured
lines: Reason 1: warn to avoid an accident

q24263.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed provided that street lighting is missing or poor.

explain.short: The flash is a signal, not a way to light the road. It is allowed even where streets are well lit.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'purché l'illuminazione esterna manchi' (provided street lighting is missing) is a condition that does not exist for flashing.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing is a signal, even on lit streets

q24264.en: Flashing the main beam (high beam) is allowed exclusively in cases of immediate danger.

explain.short: Flashing is also allowed to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake. So it is not only for immediate danger.
explain.rule: Flashing the main beam (abbaglianti) is allowed by day and by night, also in towns, for two reasons: to give a useful warning that helps avoid an accident, or to tell the vehicle in front that you want to overtake.
explain.trap: 'esclusivamente' (exclusively) is the trap: the overtaking signal is a second allowed reason.

sceneParams.caption: Not only danger: also to signal overtaking

q24265.en: Outside towns, drivers must switch off the main beam and use the dipped beam when there is a risk of dazzling other road users.

explain.short: Main beam is very strong and can blind people. If someone could be dazzled, you switch to dipped beam.
explain.rule: Outside towns you must switch from main beam (abbaglianti) to dipped beam (anabbaglianti) whenever you could dazzle someone: drivers, pedestrians, drivers on other roads, when you meet a vehicle or follow one closely.
explain.trap: 'altri utenti della strada' (other road users) covers everyone: drivers, cyclists, pedestrians.

sceneParams.caption: Risk of dazzling: switch to dipped beam

q24266.en: Outside towns, drivers must switch off the main beam and use the dipped beam if there is a risk of dazzling pedestrians.

explain.short: Pedestrians can be blinded too, and then they cannot see the road. So you switch to dipped beam.
explain.rule: Outside towns you must switch from main beam (abbaglianti) to dipped beam (anabbaglianti) whenever you could dazzle someone: drivers, pedestrians, drivers on other roads, when you meet a vehicle or follow one closely.
explain.trap: 'i pedoni' (pedestrians) are road users too: the rule protects them as well.

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrians ahead: switch to dipped beam

q24267.en: Outside towns, drivers must switch off the main beam and use the dipped beam if there is a risk of dazzling drivers of vehicles travelling on other roads.

explain.short: Your main beam can also reach a road next to yours. If those drivers could be dazzled, use dipped beam.
explain.rule: Outside towns you must switch from main beam (abbaglianti) to dipped beam (anabbaglianti) whenever you could dazzle someone: drivers, pedestrians, drivers on other roads, when you meet a vehicle or follow one closely.
explain.trap: 'su altre strade' (on other roads) is correct: the danger is not only on your own road.

sceneParams.caption: Nearby road: don't dazzle its drivers
lines: A road runs next to yours
Your main beam reaches its drivers

q24268.en: Outside towns, drivers must switch off the main beam and use the dipped beam when they are about to meet other vehicles.

explain.short: An oncoming driver would be blinded by your main beam. Switch to dipped beam before you meet.
explain.rule: Outside towns you must switch from main beam (abbaglianti) to dipped beam (anabbaglianti) whenever you could dazzle someone: drivers, pedestrians, drivers on other roads, when you meet a vehicle or follow one closely.
explain.trap: 'incrociare' means to meet a vehicle coming the other way, not to cross a junction.

sceneParams.caption: Oncoming vehicle: switch to dipped beam
lines: Switch to dipped beam in time
Main beam again after it passes

q24269.en: Outside towns, drivers must switch off the main beam and use the dipped beam when they follow a vehicle at a short distance.

explain.short: Your main beam would shine into the mirrors of the car in front and blind its driver. So you use dipped beam.
explain.rule: Outside towns you must switch from main beam (abbaglianti) to dipped beam (anabbaglianti) whenever you could dazzle someone: drivers, pedestrians, drivers on other roads, when you meet a vehicle or follow one closely.
explain.trap: 'a breve distanza' (at a short distance) is the key: close behind a vehicle you must not use main beam.

sceneParams.caption: Close behind a car: dipped beam
lines: Car close in front of you
Main beam blinds it in the mirrors

q24270.en: Outside towns, drivers must switch off the main beam and use the dipped beam after using it for a long time, to avoid draining the battery.

explain.short: The battery is not the reason. You switch to dipped beam only so that you do not dazzle other people.
explain.rule: Outside towns you must switch from main beam (abbaglianti) to dipped beam (anabbaglianti) whenever you could dazzle someone: drivers, pedestrians, drivers on other roads, when you meet a vehicle or follow one closely.
explain.trap: 'per evitare di scaricare la batteria' (to avoid draining the battery) is an invented reason.

sceneParams.caption: The reason is dazzle, not the battery
lines: Main beam for a long time: fine
The battery is not the reason

q24271.en: Outside towns, drivers must switch off the main beam and use the dipped beam only when the vehicle close in front is a car.

explain.short: Any vehicle close in front can be dazzled: truck, motorbike, bus or car. The type does not matter.
explain.rule: Outside towns you must switch from main beam (abbaglianti) to dipped beam (anabbaglianti) whenever you could dazzle someone: drivers, pedestrians, drivers on other roads, when you meet a vehicle or follow one closely.
explain.trap: 'solo quando ... è un'autovettura' (only when it is a car) is the trap: every vehicle counts.

sceneParams.caption: Any vehicle in front, not only cars

q24273.en: The symbol shown is placed on a red warning light.

explain.short: The coolant temperature symbol is on a red light, because an overheating engine is a danger.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'rosso' (red) is correct: red means danger, stop and check.

sceneParams.caption: Coolant temperature: a RED light

q24274.en: A lit red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture indicates that the engine is overheating.

explain.short: The thermometer in the waves shows the coolant is too hot. That means the engine is overheating.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'eccessivo riscaldamento del motore' (engine overheating) is exactly what this light warns about.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: the engine is overheating

q24275.en: The symbol shown is on the warning light that indicates too high a temperature of the engine coolant.

explain.short: Thermometer plus waves of liquid = coolant temperature. When lit, the coolant is too hot.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'liquido di raffreddamento' (coolant) is right: the waves stand for the liquid that cools the engine.

sceneParams.caption: Coolant temperature too high

q24276.en: The symbol shown is on a warning light that, when lit, indicates that the coolant temperature is above the limits set by the manufacturer.

explain.short: When this red light comes on, the coolant is hotter than the maker allows. The engine risks damage.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'supera i limiti stabiliti dal costruttore' (goes above the maker's limits) just means 'too hot'.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: coolant hotter than the maker's limit

q24277.en: The symbol shown is on the warning light that is part of the gauge for the temperature of the coolant flowing in the engine.

explain.short: Many cars put this red light inside the coolant temperature gauge. It is the same topic: coolant heat.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'integra l'indicatore' (is part of the gauge) is correct: light and gauge work together.

sceneParams.caption: Part of the coolant temperature gauge

q24278.en: The symbol shown marks the filler cap of the windscreen washer fluid tank.

explain.short: The washer symbol is a windscreen with a spray of water. The thermometer in waves is coolant temperature.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'liquido tergicristalli' (windscreen washer fluid) is a different symbol.

sceneParams.caption: Not the washer: coolant temperature

q24279.en: The symbol shown is on a warning light that shows the coolant level in the radiator.

explain.short: The thermometer shows heat, not quantity. This light is about coolant TEMPERATURE, not its level.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'livello' (level) is the trap: the symbol shows temperatura (temperature).

sceneParams.caption: Temperature, not level

q24280.en: The symbol shown is on the warning light that shows the temperature of the engine lubricating oil.

explain.short: The waves stand for the coolant, not the oil. Engine oil has the oil can symbol.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'olio di lubrificazione' (lubricating oil) is the trap: this light is about the coolant.

sceneParams.caption: Coolant, not engine oil

q24281.en: The symbol shown is on the warning light that marks the gauge of the temperature of the oil flowing in the engine.

explain.short: The gauge linked to this light is for the coolant. It is not an oil temperature gauge.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'temperatura dell'olio' (oil temperature) is the trap: it is the coolant temperature.

sceneParams.caption: Coolant gauge, not oil gauge

q24282.en: The symbol shown is on a warning light that, when lit, signals too high a temperature of the gearbox lubricating oil.

explain.short: This light is about the engine coolant. It has nothing to do with gearbox oil.
explain.rule: A thermometer in waves is the red warning light for engine coolant temperature (temperatura del liquido di raffreddamento). If it lights up, the engine is overheating: stop and check.
explain.trap: 'cambio di velocità' (gearbox) is the trap: the symbol is about engine coolant.

sceneParams.caption: Engine coolant, not gearbox oil

q24283.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the generator is not charging the battery.

explain.short: The battery light comes on when the battery is not getting charge. The generator (alternator) is not doing its job.
explain.rule: The battery symbol on a red light (spia) means the alternator (the generator) is not charging the battery. It does not mean the battery is flat, overcharged or must be replaced.
explain.trap: 'generatore di corrente' (power generator) is another name for the alternator.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: the generator is not charging
lines: Battery symbol on a red light

q24284.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the battery is not recharging as it should.

explain.short: When this light is on while driving, the battery is not receiving the normal charge.
explain.rule: The battery symbol on a red light (spia) means the alternator (the generator) is not charging the battery. It does not mean the battery is flat, overcharged or must be replaced.
explain.trap: 'non si sta ricaricando come previsto' (is not recharging as it should) is the correct meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: battery not recharging properly
lines: Battery symbol on a red light

q24285.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the alternator is not recharging the battery.

explain.short: The alternator makes electricity while the engine runs. If this light is on, it is not charging the battery.
explain.rule: The battery symbol on a red light (spia) means the alternator (the generator) is not charging the battery. It does not mean the battery is flat, overcharged or must be replaced.
explain.trap: 'alternatore' (alternator) is the part that should charge the battery.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: the alternator is not charging
lines: Battery symbol on a red light

q24286.en: The symbol shown, if placed on a red warning light, lets you know whether or not the battery is being correctly recharged by the alternator.

explain.short: Off = the alternator charges the battery. On while driving = it does not. So the light tells you this.
explain.rule: The battery symbol on a red light (spia) means the alternator (the generator) is not charging the battery. It does not mean the battery is flat, overcharged or must be replaced.
explain.trap: 'correttamente ricaricata o meno' (correctly recharged or not) is exactly what the light checks.

sceneParams.caption: It shows if the alternator charges the battery
lines: Battery symbol on a red light

q24287.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the battery is completely flat.

explain.short: The light does not measure how full the battery is. It only says the battery is not being charged.
explain.rule: The battery symbol on a red light (spia) means the alternator (the generator) is not charging the battery. It does not mean the battery is flat, overcharged or must be replaced.
explain.trap: 'completamente scarica' (completely flat) is the trap: with a flat battery the car would not even start.

sceneParams.caption: Not 'flat': it is not being charged
lines: Battery symbol on a red light

q24288.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the battery must be replaced at once.

explain.short: The problem is the charging, often the alternator or its belt. The battery itself may be fine.
explain.rule: The battery symbol on a red light (spia) means the alternator (the generator) is not charging the battery. It does not mean the battery is flat, overcharged or must be replaced.
explain.trap: 'sostituire subito la batteria' (replace the battery at once) is the trap: the light does not say this.

sceneParams.caption: Not 'replace the battery': charging fault
lines: Battery symbol on a red light

q24289.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the cables on the battery terminals must be swapped.

explain.short: The light never tells you to swap cables. It only says the battery is not being charged.
explain.rule: The battery symbol on a red light (spia) means the alternator (the generator) is not charging the battery. It does not mean the battery is flat, overcharged or must be replaced.
explain.trap: 'invertire l'allacciamento dei cavi' (swap the cable connections) is an invented meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Not 'swap the cables': not charging
lines: Battery symbol on a red light

q24290.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the battery is overcharged.

explain.short: The light means the opposite: the battery is NOT being charged. 'Overcharged' is wrong.
explain.rule: The battery symbol on a red light (spia) means the alternator (the generator) is not charging the battery. It does not mean the battery is flat, overcharged or must be replaced.
explain.trap: 'sovraccarica' (overcharged) is the trap: the real problem is missing charge.

sceneParams.caption: Not overcharged: NOT charging
lines: Battery symbol on a red light

q24291.en: The symbol shown is on a device that gives information about the lubricant pressure in the engine.

explain.short: The oil can symbol is about engine oil pressure. The light tells you if the pressure is right.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'pressione del lubrificante' (lubricant pressure) is correct: lubricant means engine oil.

sceneParams.caption: Oil can: engine oil pressure
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24292.en: The symbol shown can be placed on a red warning light.

explain.short: Low oil pressure can quickly ruin the engine, so this symbol is on a red (danger) light.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'può' (can) is correct: this is a red light.

sceneParams.caption: Oil pressure: a RED light
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24293.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if off while driving, indicates that the engine oil pressure is normal.

explain.short: The light comes on only when pressure is too low. If it stays off while driving, the pressure is fine.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'se spenta' (if off) is the key: off means everything is normal.

sceneParams.caption: Light off while driving: pressure normal

q24294.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates insufficient engine oil pressure.

explain.short: When this light comes on while driving, the oil is not pushed through the engine with enough pressure.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'insufficiente pressione' (insufficient pressure) is the exact meaning of this light.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: oil pressure too low
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24295.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, tells you to stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage.

explain.short: Without oil pressure the engine parts rub and break. Stop safely and switch off the engine at once.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'arrestare subito il motore' (stop the engine at once) is right: red oil light = stop now.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: stop the engine at once
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24296.en: The symbol shown can mark a yellow-amber warning light.

explain.short: In the official quiz this oil pressure symbol belongs to a RED light, because low oil pressure is a danger.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'giallo ambra' (yellow-amber) is the trap: the quiz wants red for this symbol.

sceneParams.caption: Oil pressure light: red, not amber
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24296.reviewNote: Some real cars use a similar oil can symbol on an amber oil-level light; the official answer FALSE is explained as the quiz convention (red only).

q24297.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the engine oil temperature is too low.

explain.short: The light is about oil PRESSURE being too low, not oil temperature.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'temperatura troppo bassa' (temperature too low) is the trap: the word should be pressione (pressure).

sceneParams.caption: Pressure, not temperature
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24298.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the engine uses too much oil.

explain.short: The light does not measure oil consumption. It warns that the oil pressure is too low.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'consuma troppo olio' (uses too much oil) is the trap: the light is about pressure.

sceneParams.caption: Not oil consumption: low pressure
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24299.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the gearbox lubricating oil is too thick.

explain.short: This light is about ENGINE oil pressure. It says nothing about gearbox oil.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'cambio di velocità' (gearbox) and 'denso' (thick) are both wrong here.

sceneParams.caption: Engine oil pressure, not gearbox oil
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24300.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the engine oil must be changed.

explain.short: An oil change is a planned service. This red light warns of low oil pressure, an emergency.
explain.rule: The oil can symbol is a red light for engine oil pressure. Lit while driving = oil pressure too low: stop the engine at once to avoid serious damage. Off = pressure normal.
explain.trap: 'cambiare l'olio' (change the oil) is the trap: the light means stop the engine at once.

sceneParams.caption: Not 'oil change': low pressure, stop
lines: Red light on: pressure too low

q24301.en: The symbol shown is placed on a red warning light.

explain.short: The brake symbol is on a red light, because a brake fault is a danger.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'rosso' (red) is correct: brakes are about safety.

sceneParams.caption: Brake warning: a RED light

q24302.en: The symbol shown marks the warning light for a fault in part of the braking system.

explain.short: The exclamation mark between two arcs is the brake warning. It lights up when part of the brakes has a problem.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'impianto frenante' (braking system) is right: this is the brake light.

sceneParams.caption: Brake system fault light

q24303.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, can signal excessive wear of the brake linings.

explain.short: Worn brake linings (pads) are a brake problem, so this light can warn about them.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'può' (can) is correct: worn linings are one possible cause.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: brake linings may be worn

q24304.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, can signal a low level of hydraulic brake fluid.

explain.short: Brakes work with fluid. If the fluid is low, the brakes are weak, and this light can come on.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'scarso livello del liquido' (low fluid level) is a real cause of this light.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: brake fluid may be low

q24305.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, means you must quickly have the braking system serviced or repaired.

explain.short: A brake fault is dangerous. You must have the brakes checked and fixed quickly.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'provvedere rapidamente' (act quickly) is correct: do not keep driving as if nothing happened.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: get the brakes fixed quickly

q24306.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, signals that the electronic control unit is broken.

explain.short: This light is about the brakes, not the car's electronic control unit (centralina).
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'centralina elettronica' (electronic control unit) is the trap: the symbol means brakes.

sceneParams.caption: Brakes, not the control unit

q24307.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the maker's periodic service must be done within 500 kilometres.

explain.short: A red brake light is a fault, not a service reminder. There is no '500 km' in its meaning.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'tagliando periodico' (periodic service) and '500 chilometri' are invented details.

sceneParams.caption: Brake fault, not a service reminder

q24308.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, indicates that the legal periodic inspection must be done within a month.

explain.short: The legal inspection (revisione) has its own dates. A dashboard light does not announce it.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'revisione periodica di legge' (legal periodic inspection) is the trap: this is a brake fault light.

sceneParams.caption: Brake fault, not the legal inspection

q24309.en: The symbol shown marks the place where the on-board fire extinguisher is kept.

explain.short: This symbol is the brake warning light on the dashboard. It does not show where the extinguisher is.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'estintore' (fire extinguisher) is the trap: the symbol means brakes.

sceneParams.caption: Brake light, not the extinguisher

q24310.en: The symbol shown marks a part of the electrical system with high voltage.

explain.short: The exclamation mark between arcs means a brake fault, not electrical danger.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'alta tensione' (high voltage) is the trap: the symbol is about brakes.

sceneParams.caption: Brakes, not high voltage

q24311.en: A red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, signals doors that are open or not closed properly.

explain.short: Open doors have their own symbol (a car with open doors). This one is the brake warning.
explain.rule: The exclamation mark in a circle with two arcs is the red brake warning light. It means a fault in the braking system, for example low brake fluid or worn brake pads: get it repaired soon.
explain.trap: 'portiere aperte' (open doors) is the trap: the symbol means brakes.

sceneParams.caption: Brakes, not open doors

q24312.en: The symbol shown is placed on a red warning light.

explain.short: Not wearing a seat belt is a danger, so this symbol is on a red light.
explain.rule: The person with a belt is the red seat belt warning light. Lit while driving = someone has not fastened the seat belt; usually a beeping sound comes with it, and it cannot be switched off with a button.
explain.trap: 'rosso' (red) is correct for the seat belt light.

sceneParams.caption: Seat belt warning: a RED light
lines: Person with belt = seat belt light

q24313.en: The symbol shown is on a red warning light that, if lit while driving, indicates that the driver or a passenger has not fastened the seat belt.

explain.short: The light shows a person with a belt. It comes on when someone in the car is not wearing it.
explain.rule: The person with a belt is the red seat belt warning light. Lit while driving = someone has not fastened the seat belt; usually a beeping sound comes with it, and it cannot be switched off with a button.
explain.trap: 'non hanno indossato le cinture' (have not put on the seat belts) is the right meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: someone has no seat belt on
lines: Person with belt = seat belt light

q24314.en: The red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture, if lit while driving, usually comes with a working sound signal.

explain.short: Most cars beep together with this light, to make sure you notice it.
explain.rule: The person with a belt is the red seat belt warning light. Lit while driving = someone has not fastened the seat belt; usually a beeping sound comes with it, and it cannot be switched off with a button.
explain.trap: 'in genere' (usually) is correct: a beeping sound normally comes with it.

sceneParams.caption: Lit: usually with a beeping sound
lines: Person with belt = seat belt light

q24315.en: The red warning light marked with the symbol in the picture can be switched off with a special control on the dashboard.

explain.short: There is no button to switch this light off. It goes off when everyone fastens the seat belt.
explain.rule: The person with a belt is the red seat belt warning light. Lit while driving = someone has not fastened the seat belt; usually a beeping sound comes with it, and it cannot be switched off with a button.
explain.trap: 'può essere disattivata' (can be switched off) is the trap: you fasten the belt, you don't press a button.

sceneParams.caption: No off button: fasten the belt
lines: Person with belt = seat belt light

q24316.en: The symbol shown is placed on a yellow warning light.

explain.short: The seat belt light is red, because riding without a belt is a danger.
explain.rule: The person with a belt is the red seat belt warning light. Lit while driving = someone has not fastened the seat belt; usually a beeping sound comes with it, and it cannot be switched off with a button.
explain.trap: 'giallo' (yellow) is the trap: the seat belt light is red.

sceneParams.caption: Seat belt light: red, not yellow
lines: Person with belt = seat belt light

q24317.en: The symbol shown is on the button used to set how the seat belt pretensioner works.

explain.short: The symbol is a warning light, not a button. The pretensioner (it tightens the belt in a crash) has no such button.
explain.rule: The person with a belt is the red seat belt warning light. Lit while driving = someone has not fastened the seat belt; usually a beeping sound comes with it, and it cannot be switched off with a button.
explain.trap: 'pulsante' (button) and 'pretensionatore' (pretensioner) are the trap: it is only a warning light.

sceneParams.caption: A warning light, not a button
lines: Person with belt = seat belt light
